proposedRules.eligibility: Same session, two different drivers, actual laps. Complete usable telemetry only on the measured interval.
proposedRules.flags: Whole-lap yellow/green/deleted status is context, never a veto.
proposedRules.tyreAge: No hard maximum difference and no rejection for unknown age; display known ages without assuming equal grip.
proposedRules.compound: Recorded as context; preference for matching compound only breaks time-cost ties in this prototype. All cited examples use SOFT on both cars.
proposedRules.pairing: Selected pair first if locally usable; then chronological proximity to selected laps plus pair start-time gap. At most 4 pairs, each lap used once. No hard time window in prototype.
proposedRules.localTime: Elapsed time at identical distance boundaries; gap limit 0.6 s. Estimated geometric boundaries are shared across the pool.
proposedRules.timingCheck: Compare reconstructed versus official sector time differences only in sectors intersecting the measured interval; reject error >0.35 s. Every intersected sector must have a check before assigning a winner.
proposedRules.neutral: Difference below max(0.05 s, sector timing disagreement) remains neutral.
proposedRules.summary: Report wins / checked pairs and median gain including neutral pairs. At least 2 checked independent pairs for a repeated comparison. Missing sector checks allow display of an estimate but no winner.

fastBakuSensitivityAudit.purpose: Sensitivity audit, not an eligibility rule: restrict qualifying sample to laps within 2 s of each driver fastest observed lap and 10 min of selected lap.

limitations: Three sampled sessions are not proof of season-wide availability.
Telemetry and geometric intervals provide estimates, not official mini-sector timing.

Chronological proximity alone can select a qualifying cooling lap. Counts above measure usable telemetry, not equal driving intent. Separate Baku fast-lap audit validates actual near-fastest laps without making this diagnostic a production veto.
If the selected pair has a local gap, other pair rows can still be shown, but cannot be described as confirmation of an unavailable selected-pair result.
Different tyre age, traffic, fuel, DRS and weather can explain observed differences. This prototype does not infer causes or normalize these effects.
No production source changes or UI changes were made for this research. App lint/typecheck/build/browser checks were not repeated for the temporary research prototype and JSON report.
